create_utm_grid_from_latlon: create a UtmGridMapping from a lat/lon center point with a given cell size and grid width
create_utm_grid_from_bbox: create a UtmGridMapping from a UTM bounding box with a specified cell size and zone
convert_utm_grid_to_ee_geometry: convert a UtmGridMapping to an Earth Engine Geometry Rectangle in LatLon or UTM coordinates
convert_utm_grid_to_shapely: convert a UtmGridMapping to a Shapely Polygon using the lat/lon bounding box
get_geotransform_for_location: get the geotransform tuple and EPSG code for a lat/lon location and image width in meters
